facts.text: Keller grew around a railroad, once hosting an annual fair that drew crowds from miles away, creating a homecoming vibe.
Keller sits in central Accomack County on Virginia’s Eastern Shore, a picturesque spot known for its gentle coastal scenery.
STAR Transit links Keller to neighboring towns like Cape Charles and Onley, keeping the Eastern Shore connected by bus.
Town council meetings in Keller are held monthly at 6 p.m., with the latest scheduled for May 13 after the budget hearing.
Keller’s residents cherish a down‑home, friendly atmosphere, with generational families welcoming newcomers to share in small‑town living.
